provenance.prompt: Create an original JAMVERSE '96 2D arcade basketball animation sheet for canonical captain Wicked. Use the portrait in the THIRD ROW, FOURTH COLUMN of the supplied seven-column roster portrait atlas as the face and hair identity guide; ignore all other portraits. Wicked is an adult gothic woman with long vivid crimson-red hair and two distinctive swept-back dark horns, a poised dangerous stylish expression and powerful controlled athletic build. Keep the portrait's actual hair and horn silhouette recognizable. Human anatomy: one head, two arms, two legs; no tail, wings, claws, or monster body. Black leather-inspired FULL-COVERAGE basketball performance top and high-waisted shorts with blood-red panels; court sneakers. Keep her composed and athletic, never snarling or sexualized. Consistent identity, costume, colors and proportions in every pose. Crisp hand-inked 1990s arcade sprite art with transparent background. THE GRID IS A HARD REQUIREMENT: exactly 6 rows and exactly 7 columns, 42 individual full-body figures total, each centered in a separate equal cell. Do not make five rows. Leave wide transparent gutters and outer margins; no figures touch or cross cell boundaries. Reading order left-to-right across each row, then top-to-bottom. Exact row contents: row1 idle poses1-6 then idle-ball pose1; row2 idle-ball poses2-4 then dribble poses1-4; row3 dribble poses5-10 then run pose1; row4 run poses2-8; row5 run poses9-11 then dribble-run poses1-4; row6 dribble-run poses5-11. Idle frames are subtly distinct standing variations. Ready/held-ball poses keep both hands empty because the game renders the ball separately. Dribble poses show varied right-handed low reaches, with dribble pose6 the lowest. Run poses have clear alternating stride. Dribble-run poses show a low run dribble, with pose7 the lowest reach. Every figure faces right in a consistent side three-quarter view. Feet, hair and horns are fully visible and comfortably inset from all image edges. No ball, props, words, numbers, cell borders, floor, court, shadows, glow, duplicate figure, or watermark.
